title: Invoice profiles
heading: Manage reusable invoice profiles
subtitle: Save personal or business invoice details for future requests. Submitted requests keep their original snapshot and are never rewritten by later edits.
securityTitle: Full bank account numbers are never shown again
securityDescription: Bank accounts are encrypted by the server. Editing keeps the saved value unless you explicitly choose Replace or Clear.
loadFailed: Invoice profiles are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
empty: No invoice profiles have been saved

form.title: Name
form.bankAccountHelp: Only the last few characters are shown after saving. The full value is never displayed again.
form.savedBank: The saved account is {masked}. This page cannot read the full value.
form.noSavedBank: No bank account is saved. Choose Replace to add one.
form.individualClearsBankTitle: Changing to a personal profile clears this profile's bank account
form.individualClearsBankDescription: After saving, this profile will no longer retain business tax or bank details. Previously submitted invoice requests keep their original snapshots.
form.makeDefault: Also make this the default profile

deactivate.title: Deactivate this invoice profile?
deactivate.description: It cannot be selected for new invoice requests, but existing requests and history remain available.
deactivate.defaultDescription: This is the current default. Deactivating it will not silently choose another profile. You can set a new default later, and all existing requests and history remain available.

messages.defaultSet: The default invoice profile was updated.
messages.deactivated: The invoice profile was deactivated and its history was retained.
